titleEn: At the Main Road, Stop Your Feet!

pages.text: "Mr. Pig's cart! I want to get there first!" Coco hopped ahead along the stony alley. Across the main road stood the cart of Mr. Pig, who carried flour sacks. Mom followed with a bread basket.
Near the main road, Coco hurried even more. "Mr. Pig, I'm here!" Without looking left or right, Coco stepped out toward the road. Just then, Mom caught up and held Coco's paw firmly. "Coco, wait!"

While Coco stood still in Mom's grip, a bicycle whizzed past. Ring, ring! Coco's tail curled tight. "Whew! That gave you a fright, didn't it?" Mom asked. Running without looking left and right could have meant trouble.
Mom bent her knees to meet Coco's eyes. "At the main road, our promise comes before hurrying. Shall we make three promises?" Coco tucked in their chin and nodded. "What promises?"

Mom pointed at the ground. Here the alley pebbles ended and the main-road stones began. "This is our stopping line." Mom planted her feet at the line. Coco stood firmly beside her. "At the main road, stop your feet!"

Mom taught the three promises. "One, when the pebbles end, stop your feet! Two, look left and look right! Three, hold Mom's paw to cross!" Coco clenched both paws in front of their chest. "I can keep them too!"
Coco stopped firmly before the line. Look left, look right. A cart rattled past. Coco waited with feet together. "At the main road, stop your feet!" Coco grinned.

After the cart passed, Coco held Mom's paw and crossed with steady steps. Mr. Pig clapped. "You kept your promises well!" Coco tightened the scarf knot with a paw. "I remembered my promises all by myself!"

On the way back, Coco stopped at the main road again. "One, when the pebbles end, stop your feet! Two, look left and look right! Three, hold Mom's paw to cross!" This time Coco remembered before Mom spoke.
Back at the bakery, Mom knelt in front of Coco and hugged them. "Even in a hurry, our promise comes first at the main road, right?" In Mom's arms, Coco called, "At the main road, stop your feet!"
